about: Capture-time provenance for docs/screens/*.png (#335). One row per shot, written by the session that took the pixels: sha256/canvas are properties of the bytes, origin/install/url/seed/level/layout/sampleRate/build are properties of the instrument and cannot be recovered from the PNG afterwards. `node tools/recap.js check` verifies each row against the file it addresses and against every other row of the same (seed, level, sampleRate); the vocabulary, the route verdicts and the audio-draw rule live in tools/recap.js, not here.

4abba57.note: The four blobs that draw a frame, sha256, read from the checkout that ran the capture. index.html plus the three js/ files that put a pixel on screen: js/10_assets.js makes the textures, js/20_level.js the lit materials, js/40_render.js is the rasterizer. `node tools/recap.js check` recomputes them from the tree it runs in and prints whether these frames still show what that tree ships (#536). The session that took these pixels proved this build off the wire, blob by blob, against the deployed page.

shots.note: RE-TAKEN from the DEPLOYED page for #882 at build a32a8a6. The previous pass bound cc0a3e3; since then #886 (a1c152d) gave a slab's underside its own sheet - the joist is baked into CEILS.SOFFIT and fetched through the mip chain instead of being raised per pixel off the ceiling's tile, so the relief is filtered by the chain at the distance a second storey is actually looked up at. That moved two of the four blobs that draw a frame, js/40_render.js and js/10_assets.js, between cc0a3e3 and this checkout, so recap labelled the cc0a3e3 rows FRAME-STALE and the front page was describing a picture that no longer ships. Earlier causes are NOT restated as this pass's: #879's shadow band, #880's joist pitch and #19's sheet re-key are already inside the bytes this frame replaces, so they account for none of the movement here. This pass is the same eight poses re-run against the deploy, which serves main's bytes: index.html and all eleven js/ blobs served by that URL sha256-match this checkout, twelve for twelve, proved before the shutter. Route: `node tools/livecap.js frames --url <deployed ?dev=1&seed=60&boot=0> --vp 1440x763`, one page load and one boot per pose, DEV.freeze(true), DEV.set("grain",0), DEV.clear() before the pose, shutter from the canvas after DEV.tick; the pose table is checked into tools/livecap.js (FRAMES) and --vp pins the display surface to the 1440x763 every frame in docs/screens carries. Chromium gave RGBA; committed through tools/png_rgb.js. Every seat, layout and audio term below was read back out of the page that drew the frame, and every mean re-measured from these bytes with tools/recap.js's own decoder. Pose: the spawn seat, then DEV.clear() and DEV.spawn('grunt', 1, 6); the route's own seat search needed no turn this deal and left him dead on the view line 6.00 m out with 255 raster px of him painted. Frame mean 60.61, which is +0.03 on the frame it replaces, and 0.23% of its pixels (2,512 of 1,098,720) differ from those bytes by the kept-pixel rule (summed |dRGB| over 18, counted over the whole 1440x763 frame, which is the rule tools/livecap.js states); they fall 2,443 in the top third, 0 in the middle and 69 in the bottom, over rows 0-739 and columns 565-1163. Band means 60.4 / 64.0 / 57.5. Dark census: 0 rows under 24 and none under 34; the frame it replaces reads 0 and 0. Layout signature 4083630493 under seed 60 on this instrument - identical to the row this frame replaces, so this is a picture change and not a re-deal. Audio term: SND.ac.sampleRate read 44100 in the page that drew this frame, the same instrument term those rows state (#404).
